dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000pl78](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000pl78) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 136.164 depth occurred on Jan 20 2025 7km S of Lian. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 13.9717 longitude 120.6437. It impacted 1782705 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
